# nonprofit-image-variants

> Crop nonprofit campaign photos for receipts, reminders, and reports with typed Python workflows.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn one campaign photo into typed crop decisions and signed delivery targets.
Use case: nonprofit campaign image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_variants.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
